item.title: Earlier context housekeeping for long chats
item.summary: Murph now compacts very long conversation context at 132k tokens instead of 164k, reducing repeated context processing while preserving the active task.
item.details: Personal conversations may show the existing context progress update sooner. Group conversations continue to keep that maintenance update out of the room, and very long tool-heavy turns have less uninterrupted headroom than under the previous setting.
